headline: Hawai'i Hilo have as many wins as defeats again
dek: Hawai'i Hilo beat Dominican (CA) at home and now have six wins, three draws and six defeats. They went into the match with more defeats than wins, and Dominican (CA), level before it, now have more.
displaced_by: results night: Hawai'i Hilo's win took them from a losing record to level and put Dominican (CA) below level; the other results' meanings (Hawai'i Pacific level at the top, Flagler's unbeaten conference season) are already printed on their cards
